g1.label: 1. Tharpe's guitar playing was a blueprint for
g1.why: Her electric guitar style is now seen as an early model for rock'n'roll.

g2.label: 2. In the 1950s, songs by Black artists were
g2.why: White artists frequently re-recorded their songs and had the bigger hits.

g3.label: 3. Radio stations at the time had been
g3.why: Stations were segregated, so Black and white music was played separately.

g4.label: 4. Motown was founded by
g4.why: Motown was founded by Black entrepreneurs in Detroit.

g5.label: 5. Rhythm and blues was transformed into

g6.label: 6. Almost every major pop genre was shaped by
g6.why: The article's point is that Black musicians shaped nearly every pop genre.

g1.label: 1. Blues and gospel ___
g1.why: A plural subject takes 'were' in the past passive.

g2.label: 2. Motown ___
g2.why: A singular subject takes 'was' in the past passive.

g3.label: 3. Today, this musical history ___
g3.why: Present passive with a singular subject takes 'is' + past participle.

g4.label: 4. By the time rock'n'roll became mainstream, many songs ___
g4.why: Past perfect passive: 'had been' + past participle for an earlier action.

g5.label: 5. Aretha Franklin's records ___
g5.why: Present passive with a plural subject takes 'are'.

g6.label: 6. In the future, more attention ___
g6.why: Future passive is 'will be' + past participle.

g7.label: 7. The contribution should ___
g7.why: After a modal the passive is 'be' + past participle.

g8.label: 8. Soul music ___
g8.why: Singular subject in the past passive takes 'was'.

g1.label: 1. gospel emotion with rhythm and blues
g1.why: Soul combines gospel feeling with rhythm and blues.

g2.label: 2. the Detroit record label
g2.why: Motown was the Detroit label founded by Black entrepreneurs.

g3.label: 3. danceable 1970s style from R&B
g3.why: Disco grew out of rhythm and blues in the 1970s.

g4.label: 4. rhythmic speech over a beat
g4.why: Hip hop sets rhythmic speech over a beat, borrowing from funk.

g5.label: 5. a song recorded again by another artist
g5.why: A new recording of an existing song is a cover.

g6.label: 6. official acknowledgment for creating something
g6.why: To receive credit is to be officially named as the creator.

g7.label: 7. R&B stands for rhythm and
g7.why: R&B is short for rhythm and blues.

g8.label: 8. creates a style others follow
g8.why: A pioneer is the first to develop something others build on.
